name: a street of houses
did: Doors that swing, and Town rebuilt as a neighbourhood: eight one-storey houses with six different internal layouts, two two-storey ones with stairs and an upper floor, a bikers' clubhouse and a business, all with interiors and doors that open when you walk up to them.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
